# Dažbog at work: solar & renewable energy, agriculture, food & harvest, and the myths that got there first

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Dažbog** works now.

Dažbog is known almost entirely from external, often hostile, sources. The Slavs left no extensive native mythology, so his story must be reconstructed from the fragments preserved by Christian chroniclers, folk invocations, and comparative Indo-European study.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **5 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Dažbog
- **Pantheon:** Slavic
- **Domain of influence:** Sun, Wealth, Giving
- **Pattern seats:** 5
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Society & Spirit · Commerce & Governance · Home & Lifestyle
- **Strongest seat:** Solar & Renewable Energy
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 63 of 271

## The Myth at Work

**The Kievan Pantheon.** The Povest' vremennykh let ('Tale of Bygone Years,' c.  1113) records that after Prince Vladimir's conversion, the idols of Perun, Khors, Dazhbog, Stribog, Simargl, and Mokosh were thrown into the Dnieper. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**Dabog the Giver.** In Serbian and broader South Slavic folklore, Dabog or Dajbog appears in blessings and oaths: 'Dajbog da... ' ('May God give that... — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Solar & Renewable Energy

*Photovoltaics, solar thermal, and the light economy. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The Slavic sun, son of the smith-god Svarog; his name means “giving god” — the Kievan pantheon’s daylight itself.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Agriculture, Food & Harvest

*Farming, grain, food production, and agtech. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The sheaf the sun ripens; the harvest is his generosity made grain.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Dažbog performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Dajbog still invoked across the South Slavic world; Rodnovery honors him as solar patron.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Finance, Wealth & Commerce

*Banking, investment, and commercial enterprise. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The giving god; prosperity dispensed from the sun.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Gems, Jewelry & Luxury Materials

*Diamonds, gemstones, and precious materials. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*Gold and amber, sunlight made solid; the treasures of a giving god.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Dažbog performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

## The Long Employment

Dažbog survives most clearly in South Slavic invocations of Dajbog and in place-names and personal names across Slavic-speaking regions.  Modern Slavic Rodnovery (Native Faith) movements honor him as a solar and prosperity deity. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

The atlas is not a horoscope. Seats are earned from the sources — argued, weighted, published — and every one of them can be challenged at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). A match that cannot survive an argument does not survive review. That is the whole trick: the patterns are claims, and claims can be tested.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in solar & renewable energy, agriculture, food & harvest, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/dazhbog/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
